title: OFFICIAL TRAILER | Alone with Wolves: / "Surviving with Wolves: 365 Days in the Wildest Siberia"
description:
Link to watch the full movie:         https://youtu.be/-o-b-cHyFS4

A wildlife documentary following two naturalists on a grueling 9-month self-sufficient expedition into the remote heart of Siberia — the wild Putorana Plateau. The mission: to encounter untamed wolves that have never had contact with humans, observe pack behavior in pristine wilderness, and uncover the true nature of these apex predators.

9 months of isolation through extreme Arctic winter, the massive spring migration of wild reindeer, awakening bears, and the relentless quest to discover a hidden wolf den.

The Journey to Siberia / Bushcraft in Siberia  https://youtu.be/-A1Hc2VmO6M
